task: Add English vegan ingredient classifier + auto language dispatcher
rationale: Wedge V2 expansion from docs/WEDGE.md. The Korean classifier (V1) is shipped and integrated into CameraScreen. Next step in the wedge's V2 plan is English labels — needed for travelers buying US/EU products. After both work standalone, we need a thin dispatcher so the camera flow doesn't have to branch on language at every call site.

stories.title: English vegan classifier with token-boundary matching
acceptanceCriteria: classifyEnglishVegan('milk, sugar, salt') returns verdict='unsafe' with matched 'milk'
classifyEnglishVegan('whole milk powder, beef stock') flags both milk and beef
classifyEnglishVegan('milky way bar, sugar') does NOT false-match 'milk' inside 'milky'
classifyEnglishVegan('flour, sugar, vegetable oil') returns verdict='safe'
classifyEnglishVegan('flour, natural flavoring') returns verdict='caution' (flavoring is amber)
Dictionary covers >= 30 animal terms across meat, dairy, eggs, seafood, additives
All new tests pass under `bun run test`

stories.title: Handle English-specific lexical variation (plurals, capitalization, dashes)
acceptanceCriteria: 'Milk' (title case) matches the same as 'milk'
'EGGS' (uppercase) matches 'egg'
'eggs' (plural) matches 'egg' canonical
'pork-derived' matches 'pork'
Flavor-suffix exclusion works for English: 'beef-flavored chips' does not flag 'beef' as unsafe (it's an amber flavoring)
All new and previously-passing tests still pass under `bun run test`

stories.title: Multilingual dispatcher that picks the right classifier based on detected language
acceptanceCriteria: detectLanguage('우유, 설탕') returns 'ko'
detectLanguage('milk, sugar') returns 'en'
detectLanguage('') returns 'unknown' (falls back to caution)
classifyVegan('우유, 설탕') routes to Korean classifier and returns unsafe with '우유'
classifyVegan('milk, sugar') routes to English classifier and returns unsafe with 'milk'
classifyVegan('日本語のテスト') returns verdict='caution' with reason about unsupported language (does not crash)
Existing Korean and English classifier tests continue to pass — no regressions
All new and previously-passing tests still pass under `bun run test` AND `bun run typecheck` exits clean

completionPromise: All 3 stories have passes=true with verified evidence in progress.md, and the full test suite (`bun run health`) exits clean.
